∀ {ε : ℝ} (g : ℝ → ℝ),
  (∀ (x : ℝ), ‖deriv g x‖ ≤ 1) →
    0 < ε → (∀ (x y : ℝ), x ≠ y → ‖g x - g y‖ ≥ ε * ‖x - y‖) → Function.Injective fun x => x + ε * g x
